upstream.target: x86_64 Linux LP64 static library, cmake -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=FALSE -DWITH_JPEG8=1 -DWITH_TURBOJPEG=FALSE -DPNG_SUPPORTED=FALSE -DWITH_SIMD=FALSE

summary.en: Strict ISO C17 runtime and initial Tier 0 decompression safety/functional proofs for mozjpeg 5.0.0 (`jutils.c`, `jerror.c`, `jcomapi.c`, `jpeg_calc_output_dimensions`, `jpeg_save_markers`, and decompression state/teardown); header/entropy/IDCT scanline decode proofs are not done.
summary.zh: 针对 mozjpeg 5.0.0 的严格 ISO C17 运行时及首批 Tier 0 解码安全与功能证明（涵盖 `jutils.c`、`jerror.c`、`jcomapi.c`、`jpeg_calc_output_dimensions`、`jpeg_save_markers` 及状态/清理函数）；完整头部解析、熵解码、IDCT 与扫描线解码证明尚未完成。
